note: Reviewed expectation bands for Migration 036. A band reads one publication's own measure (a rank range of one list scope, or a grade range of one scale dimension); no band crosses publications or scales and no universal expectation number exists. The outcome rule of every band is a DISI convention, stated in the band: met = MLB reach (plus a career-bWAR floor where the source scale defines a role), exceeded = the stated career-bWAR floor. Grades band on the numeric base (45+ and 45- band with 45); the qualifier stays on the observation.

families.family_label: MLB Pipeline Top-30 international signing class rank

bands.expectation_statement: Ranked 1-10 of the 30 international amateur prospects MLB Pipeline listed for a signing class at signing time. The list orders prospects within their class and states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.

Ranked 11-20 of the 30 international amateur prospects MLB Pipeline listed for a signing class at signing time. The list states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.

Ranked 21-30 of the 30 international amateur prospects MLB Pipeline listed for a signing class at signing time. The list states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 1-10 on Baseball America's MLB-wide Top 100 prospects list. The list orders prospects and states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 11-50 on Baseball America's MLB-wide Top 100 prospects list. The list states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 51-100 on Baseball America's MLB-wide Top 100 prospects list. The list states no outcome; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.

Ranked 1-5 on a FanGraphs single-organization prospect list. An organization rank depends on that system's depth and is not comparable across organizations; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 6-10 on a FanGraphs single-organization prospect list. Not comparable across organizations; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 11-30 on a FanGraphs single-organization prospect list. Not comparable across organizations; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.
Ranked 31 or lower on a FanGraphs single-organization prospect list. Not comparable across organizations; DISI convention: MLB reach meets the expectation, 10+ career bWAR exceeds it.

families.family_label: FanGraphs future value (FV, 20-80 scale, numeric base)

bands.expectation_statement: FV 60+: the 20-80 future-value scale describes an all-star-calibre peak. DISI convention mapping that role to a career: 15+ career bWAR meets it, 30+ exceeds it.
FV 55: the scale describes an above-average regular. DISI convention: 10+ career bWAR meets it, 15+ exceeds it.
FV 50: the scale describes an average everyday player or mid-rotation starter. DISI convention: 5+ career bWAR meets it, 10+ exceeds it.
FV 45: the scale describes a platoon or role player, back-end starter or reliever. DISI convention: 2+ career bWAR meets it, 5+ exceeds it.
FV 40 or lower: the scale describes a bench, depth or up-and-down role. DISI convention: MLB reach meets it, 2+ career bWAR exceeds it.
